name: Létavértes (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and blue triangles, charged at the centre with the town arms of Létavértes (a crowned red shield with a white bird, a star and a crescent, with a helm and red and blue mantling) above the name LÉTAVÉRTES in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
